sentence: This project builds tools that automatically generate hardware accelerators for edge devices while meeting latency and hardware platform constraints.
This project studies the mathematics of partial differential equations that arise in general relativity and in quantum physics.
This project uses snake venom to study how new gene regulatory networks evolve.
This project engineers bacteria to sense proteins on cancer cells and respond with a toxic payload that fights tumors.
This project studies which genes are controlled by proteins that sense metals in a heat-loving bacterium.
This project builds an imaging system that uses artificial intelligence to read Gram stain slides automatically.
This project covers research in genetics and genomics, including animal, plant, microbial and evolutionary genetics.
This project brings researchers together to study how quantum field theory, homotopy theory and operator algebras can describe complicated physical systems.
This project develops statistical methods to detect changes in data when the signal after the change varies in unpredictable ways.
This project uses DNA preserved in coral skeletons to study how corals and their microbes respond to a changing ocean.
This project works with digital twin technology, which builds real-time virtual models of physical systems, on an offshore structure model.
This project develops a radar sensing system that detects falls in older adults and measures movement and physiological patterns without cameras.
This project builds a data storage system that archives data and keeps an offsite copy for disaster recovery.
This project studies how urbanization changes the diet, gut microbiome and behavior of raccoons.
This project combines terrestrial, airborne and satellite data to build a detailed gridded geospatial database for agricultural modeling.
